source_text: Adult female Anopheles mosquitoes resting indoor were collected in thirty rooms, with the use of electric aspirators and torches between 06.00 a.m. and 10.00 a.m. from October, 2014 end of rainy season to April, 2015 beginning of rainy season except in January, 2015 due to intense harmattan... Molecular (PCR) analysis of ninety-six (96) morphologically identified female An. funestus sensu lato collected from Akaka-Remo between October, 2014 (late rainy season) and April, 2015 (early rainy season) revealed that they all belong to An. funestus s.s. Anopheles funestus is the most abundant mosquito species (84%; n = 315 from a total of 376 mosquitoes collected)
